# Agent Manifest Ambassador

A guided interface for generating Agent Manifest v1.0 declarations.

## Canonical URL

https://agent-manifest.github.io/agent-manifest-ambassador/

## Source repository

https://github.com/agent-manifest/agent-manifest-ambassador

## What it does

Ambassador is a conversational generator that produces Agent Manifest v1.0
JSON declarations. It guides users through each required field and outputs
a declaration ready for submission to the Diplomat registration API.

It is a tool, not the specification. The specification lives at:
https://agent-manifest-spec.org/

## Specification

- Spec:       https://agent-manifest-spec.org/spec/v1.0/agent_manifest_v1.0.html
- JSON Schema: https://agent-manifest-spec.org/spec/v1.0/schema.json
- DOI:        https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18833956
- License:    CC BY 4.0
- Author:     Hernán Alfredo Capucci
- ORCID:      https://orcid.org/0009-0008-7216-3032

- Ambassador (this tool): https://agent-manifest.github.io/agent-manifest-ambassador/
